introduction_text:
ITO Excellence Award Felicitation Ceremony 2026–27

Dear Sir/Madam,

Greetings from Indian Talent Olympiad!

We are delighted to invite you to the ITO Excellence Award Felicitation Ceremony 2026–27, celebrating the outstanding contributions of Principals, Coordinators, and Teachers in the field of education.

EVENT DETAILS:
Date: 23rd November 2026
Venue: Bangalore (detailed address will be shared shortly)
Time: 10:00 AM to 1:00 PM

Kindly complete this form to confirm your participation and provide the necessary details. Please read the event guidelines and consent statements carefully before submitting your response.

Important: This invitation is strictly for the invited individual. Accompanying persons, including family members, friends, colleagues, or other guests, are not permitted. Entry will be subject to event registration and verification.

web_form_fields.options:
Event Guidelines and Declaration

Please read the following guidelines carefully and confirm your agreement before proceeding with event registration.

Accuracy of Information: I confirm that all personal and professional details provided by me are accurate and complete.

Individual Invitation Only: I understand that this invitation and registration are strictly for the invited individual. No accompanying persons are permitted, including family members, friends, colleagues, or other guests.

E-Pass and Entry Requirements: I understand that entry to the event is subject to successful registration, generation of a valid E-Pass, and verification at the venue.

Compliance with Event Guidelines: I agree to follow the event schedule, venue instructions, security protocols, and all guidelines communicated by Indian Talent Olympiad (ITO).

Venue Details: I understand that the detailed venue address and any additional event instructions will be communicated separately.

Photography and Videography Consent: I consent to being photographed and/or filmed during the event and understand that these photographs and videos may be used by ITO for event documentation, promotional materials, publications, and official communication.
